title: Moving tests to a new file and adding a platform guard is not a removal
text:
diff --git a/app/core.py b/app/core.py
--- a/app/core.py
+++ b/app/core.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def total(items):
-    return sum(item.price for item in items)
+    return sum(item.price * item.qty for item in items)
diff --git a/tests/test_core.py b/tests/test_core.py
deleted file mode 100644
--- a/tests/test_core.py
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,4 +0,0 @@
-import unittest
-class T(unittest.TestCase):
-    def test_total(self):
-        self.assertEqual(total([Item(2, 1)]), 2)
diff --git a/tests/test_total.py b/tests/test_total.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_total.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+import unittest
+class T(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_total(self):
+        self.assertEqual(total([Item(2, 1)]), 2)
+    def test_total_uses_quantity(self):
+        self.assertEqual(total([Item(2, 3)]), 6)
diff --git a/tests/test_paths.py b/tests/test_paths.py
--- a/tests/test_paths.py
+++ b/tests/test_paths.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 import unittest
 class T(unittest.TestCase):
+    @unittest.skipIf(sys.platform == "win32", "posix paths only")
     def test_posix_path(self):
         self.assertEqual(join("a", "b"), "a/b")
intent: 合計金額の計算に数量を反映する。
rationale: The deleted definition reappears in a new test file together with a new test, and skipIf narrows where a test runs without removing it. Neither is a loss of regression checks.
